The archive behavior matches what I want: archived links should stay out of both “All” and “To read,” remain searchable within “Archived,” and be easy to restore.

I do still want a permanent Delete option for links I genuinely no longer need. It should be clearly separate from Archive, available for both regular and archived bookmarks, and ask for confirmation because deletion can’t be undone. Once that’s added, this flow will be complete.
